scope: Known, previously executed S1 and S2 mechanisms ONLY; not a general AutoModelica library or model discovery engine.

MTO.description: Accepted orders create unprepared work, preparation drains that work into prepared-but-undelivered stock, dispatch drains prepared work, deliveries accumulate.
MTO.limitations: Arrival and response policies require separate substantive evidence; all parameters in S2 are hypothetical.

MTS.description: An exogenous production plan fills finished-goods inventory independently of orders; accepted orders form a shipping backlog.
MTS.limitations: Two lookup functions are separately authored mathematical policy; not supplied by SystemDynamics Level and Rate.

blocklist: inference from paid sales to unobserved lost demand
